lead: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art character sprite atlas for a Godot life-story RPG. Primary request: ONE atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns and SIX equal rows, 24 full body sprites, NO labels, NO text, NO separators. Every cell has one centered isolated character, generous transparent margin, same bottom baseline. Rows are one same male protagonist at ages 5, 11, 17, 26, 48, 72 respectively. Columns: front neutral standing; front left foot forward walking; front right foot forward walking; front speaking and lifting one hand. Maintain identical body scale and costume within each row. Short tousled black hair with fringe, soft rounded face, rectangular black top rim eyeglasses from teen onward, cream shirt under black jacket with gray hood and light drawstrings for teen and young adult. Child ochre sweatshirt, schoolchild teal uniform, middle aged muted navy cardigan and gray at temples, elder silver hair and warm brown cardigan. Youth and adult appearance based on the user supplied portrait in this conversation. Style: crisp low resolution 2D overworld pixel sprites with strong dark outlines, tiny readable faces, 3-head-tall proportions, coherent limited palette, deliberately stepped pixel edges, simple expressive gestures like narrative indie RPGs, more detail than placeholder blocks. Flat colors, minimal shading, no antialiasing, no realism, no shadow backgrounds. Exact regular 4x6 cell grid covering whole canvas. All sprites entirely inside their cells. Transparent background.
